runbook_fixes.now: the queue's Reject calls POST /spaces/{space_id}/moderation/trash/reply/{id}; the global POST /moderation/trash/reply/{id} is the same action
Restore on a trashed topic republishes it at once and returns exactly the reputation that was taken; there is no separate Approve step
the bogus-action message is in data.params.action; the top-level message is 'Invalid parameter(s): action'
for a silenced member the reply composer is replaced by the notice 'Your account is currently silenced and cannot post.'; Lift restriction is on the Banned members tab
the subtitle for one flag reads '1 pending flag across the spaces you moderate'
Trash reads 'No topics in the trash.' (Topics tab) and 'No replies in the trash.' (Replies tab).
